title: About Motor Profiler and IPMM15B’s problem
content:
We’ve been using the Nucleo-F446RE + IHM09M2 + IPMM15B hardware setup. We’ve tested voltages of 50V, 80V, and 100V using transformer modules connected to a GPS-2303 DC power supply. We’ve also tried 167V with a different power supply.

However, only the 50V setup worked properly with the Motor Profiler. The only issue with 50V is that the motor could not reach a sufficient speed to “start profiler” and got stuck at 28%. The other voltages failed to even complete “Offset Detection”, getting stuck at 7% while displaying a “Driver Protection” error simultaneously. What factors could be causing this issue?
